criteria.reason: Contract text starts the reviewer with --allowedTools for gh pr view/diff/comment/review and gh api; Jest text test passes.
criteria.statement: The headless reviewer that `request-review tool=claude` starts is permitted to run `gh`: its `claude -p "/code-review <pr-url> --comment"` invocation carries a permission setting that allows `gh`, so a default project's reviewer is not refused on every `gh` call

criteria.reason: Merge contract matches on the pr-head observed headRefOid, never context.head; Jest merge test and custody pr-head stub-gh tests pass.
criteria.statement: A `merge` that follows an `await-approval` park reads the PR's `headRefOid` at merge time and passes that id to `gh pr merge --match-head-commit`, not `context.head`, so a park push that moved the PR head does not make the merge fail with `Head branch was modified`

criteria.reason: custody.test.js (temp git repo, stub gh): .trd-state-only difference passes; shipped-file difference fails naming the file.
criteria.statement: Before merging with the re-read head, the merge proves that head's code equals the custody anchor: a difference confined to `.trd-state/` counts as equal and the merge proceeds; a difference in any file outside `.trd-state/` is not proved equal and no merge is run

criteria.reason: await-approval step 3 compares PR author with gh api user and says someone else must approve; Jest test passes.
criteria.statement: When the PR's author is the account this run uses, the `await-approval` wait reason says the PR's author is this run's account and another person must approve, rather than asking the owner to approve their own PR

criteria.reason: await-approval sets remoteResume true only with the workflow file and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY listed, else false plus an ISSUES line; Jest test passes.
criteria.statement: `await-approval trigger=github-actions` records `remoteResume: true` only when the repository secret the resume workflow needs (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) is present; when it is absent the run records `remoteResume: false` and adds an ISSUES line saying so

criteria.reason: wait-ci uses the merge commit (mergeCommit.oid, gh run list --commit) when context.merged is true; Jest test passes.
criteria.statement: A `wait-ci` step placed after `merge` waits on the checks of the merge commit, not on the PR's head commit

criteria.reason: Real sequencer: wait-ci failed gives status stuck, wait-ci is re-handed out, release result stays null.
criteria.statement: When the merge commit's checks fail, the run stops at that post-merge `wait-ci` and the following `release` step does not run

criteria.reason: Fresh Jest run, all ship-review.test.js tests pass. A review by the gh login, on the head commit and submitted after the request is recognised. Another login, an older commit and a submission before the request are each not recognised and named. One match among failing reviews is found. The match is made in code (matchToolReview in ship-review.js), and both copies of the request-review contract reference it.
criteria.statement: `request-review tool=claude` recognises a review as the tool's only when all of these hold: its author is the login `gh api user` returns, it is on the PR's current head commit, and it was submitted after this step requested it. A review that fails any one of them is not recognised, and the match is made in code, not by judgment
